meta.description: Together AI SDK patterns for TypeScript — client setup, chat completions, streaming, structured output, function calling, embeddings, image generation, fine-tuning, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints

copy.tagline: 用 TypeScript 调用 Together AI 的各类 AI 模型能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用 TypeScript 接入 Together AI 的聊天、生成、微调等 API
copy.tagline_en: Call Together AI models from TypeScript for chat, generation, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Together AI APIs in TypeScript

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以使用 Together AI 的 TypeScript SDK 调用 200 多个开源模型，完成聊天、流式输出、结构化 JSON、函数调用、图片生成、嵌入向量和微调等任务。
howto.when: 当用户要求使用 Together AI 的开源模型（如 Llama、Qwen、Mistral、DeepSeek）进行推理、生成图片或嵌入向量时触发。

say.text: 用 FLUX.1-schnell 生成一张日落山景图。
用 Qwen3.5 9B 从文本中提取事件信息，输出 JSON。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Together AI TypeScript SDK to access 200+ open-source models for chat completions, streaming, structured JSON output, function calling, image generation, embeddings, and fine-tuning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to use Together AI open-source models (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek) for inference, image generation, or embeddings.

say_en.text: Use Together AI's Llama 3.3 70B model to explain TypeScript generics.
say_en.note: Claude will call the Together AI chat completions API to generate the answer.

say_en.text: Generate a sunset mountain landscape image with FLUX.1-schnell.
say_en.note: Claude will call the Together AI image generation API and return the image URL.

say_en.text: Extract event details from text using Qwen3.5 9B and output JSON.
say_en.note: Claude will use structured output to return results conforming to a JSON schema.
